[[Dervish Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for dervishes by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Dervish Light Breastplate|Light Breastplate]]
*[[Dervish Hooked Leggings|Hooked Leggings]]
*[[Dervish Padded Sandals|Padded Sandals]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 150{{iron}}, 150{{hide}}, 15{{Deldrimor Steel}}, 15{{Leather}} and 30{{plat}}
